description: This file contains unit tests for the ImageAttachmentController class, focusing on retrieving various theme images like logos and banners, and verifying the HTTP response headers and content returned by the controller. It also tests behavior with invalid input.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ImageAttachmentController's image retrieval functions and HTTP response headers.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before any tests run, specifically loading fixture data for themes.

methods.name: testClientLogo
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the client logo image and verifies response headers and content length.

methods.name: testClientBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the client banner image, checking headers and content size.

methods.name: testLoginBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the login banner image, verifying headers and content size.

methods.name: testInvalidImageName
methods.description: Tests the controller's response to an invalid image name request, expecting a 400 status code.
